description: Stereo liquid filter, a separate core per channel morphing between low-pass, band-pass and high-pass, with a soft-clipping drive stage and span controls that offset the right channel from the left

params.text: Sets the cutoff frequency, from 15Hz to 20kHz
Sets the resonance, emphasising the frequencies around the cutoff; high settings drive the filter into self-oscillation
Morphs the filter output from low-pass through band-pass to high-pass
Offsets the cutoff frequency of the right channel from the left, which spreads the filter across the stereo field
Offsets the resonance of the right channel from the left
Offsets the filter mode of the right channel from the left
Sets the gain into the filter, soft-clipping the signal once it passes 10V peak to peak; with a cable in the DRIVE input the knob attenuates that voltage instead
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the FREQ input before it reaches the cutoff frequency
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the RES input before it reaches the resonance
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the MODE input before it reaches the filter mode
Picks the character of the resonance: MILD keeps it smooth and musical, WILD pushes it into aggressive distortion

inputs.text: The right input; with nothing patched here the left input feeds both channels
Modulates the drive gain, through the DRIVE knob
Modulates the cutoff frequency, through the FREQ attenuverter
Modulates the resonance, through the RES attenuverter
Modulates the filter mode, through the MODE attenuverter
Sets the cutoff frequency one octave per volt, so a self-oscillating filter plays in tune across four to five octaves
Modulates the offset in cutoff frequency between the two channels
Modulates the offset in resonance between the two channels
Modulates the offset in filter mode between the two channels

outputs.text: The left channel after the filter
The right channel after the filter

inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the left input.
inputs.6: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
